## TRA Timeline

#### JH Capital business combination announcement

- 2017-06-28: Investment Agreement signed with JH Capital Group Holdings, LLC and the Founding Members; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit D
- 2017-06-30: 8-K filed disclosing the Investment Agreement and form-of TRA (preamble dated `[ ] 2017`, signatures blank)

#### Deal termination

- 2018-05-31: Investment Agreement terminated by mutual agreement; form-of TRA never executed
- 2018-06-25: Sirius International Insurance Group merger announced (non-Up-C, no TRA component)
- 2018-11-05: Sirius merger closes; Easterly survives as Sirius Acquisitions Holding Company III; CIK ceases filing as EACQ

## Explanation

Easterly Acquisition Corp was a Delaware SPAC that announced an Up-C-style business combination with JH Capital Group Holdings, LLC on June 28, 2017, with a form-of Tax Receivable Agreement attached as Exhibit D to the Investment Agreement. The form-of TRA would have obligated the post-combination public corporation (to be renamed JH Capital Group Holdings, Inc.) to pay Class B Members a share of realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on Class B Unit exchanges into JH Capital Group Holdings, LLC. The preamble was dated `[ ] 2017` with blank signature pages, and the contract was never executed because Easterly and JH Capital mutually terminated the Investment Agreement on May 31, 2018. Easterly subsequently closed a non-TRA Sirius International Insurance merger on November 5, 2018 and ceased filing under this CIK. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
